title: Web Hosting Plans Renewal Terms and Auto-Renew Attempts
content:
**Web Hosting Plans — renewal terms**

**1. When a renewal may be charged.** A renewal may be charged only while the plan status is active or suspended, as the plan's hosting record shows.

**2. Pricing clause — no longer in force.** The clause "A renewal is billed at the regular rate of the tier and term length that the new term will have (the regular 12, 24 or 36-month rate multiplied by the months, or the 1-month price for a 1-month term, with no setup fee), less the account tier's hosting discount percentage, rounded half up to the cent" is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current Web Hosting Plans renewal pricing rules and is not applied as written here. The account hosting discount percentage this clause named (the hosting discount percentage of the customer's account tier under Harborline Customer Accounts) and the per-tier regular and 1-month rates of the price schedule remain the figures of record.

**3. Length and tier of the new term.** The new term length is the current one unless a scheduled term change applies, and a scheduled downgrade's target tier sets the rates when it is applied at that renewal.

**4. Start of the new term.** The new term always starts on the previous term end date, even when the renewal is paid late.

**5. Auto-renew attempts.** Auto-renew attempts run only while the plan's auto-renew setting is on. The first auto-renew attempt runs the tier's first-attempt number of calendar days before the term end date, and after a decline retries run on each of the tier's retry days before the term end date, using the funding order of the Harborline Customer Accounts charter.

**6. End of the cycle.** The current renewal cycle runs from the first attempt day (the term end date less the first-attempt days) up to and including the term end date, and its declined attempts are the declined auto-renew attempts of the plan dated in that span. When every attempt of the cycle has declined — the declined attempts equal one plus the number of retry days — no further automatic attempt is made and the plan follows the suspension rules after its term ends.

**7. Scheduled cancellation.** A plan in cancel-pending is never renewed; the cancellation must first be withdrawn.

**Cycle illustration (hypothetical term end date 22 May, first attempt 7 days before, retry days 3 and 1).** The cycle runs from 15 May through 22 May. Attempts fall on 15, 19 and 21 May; with one plus two retry days, three declined attempts complete the cycle, after which no further automatic attempt is made.

superseded_clauses: A renewal is billed at the regular rate of the tier and term length that the new term will have (renewal_rate_12mo, renewal_rate_24mo or renewal_rate_36mo times the months, or monthly_rate_no_commitment for a 1-month term, with no setup fee), less the account tier's hosting_discount_pct, rounded half up to the cent.
